qualitative_assessment.kind: scoped engineering interpretation of the original qualitative outline; not a newly invented numeric cutoff or statistical equivalence test

milestone_context.reason: At16K the B1 output throughput is0.599 of4K, remains the same order, and every phase/window completes without failure. All five16K TPOT tail windows remain stable; the first TTFT window is retained and later windows do not deteriorate.

final_context.reason: At the tested>=32K input band, all five windows complete and the throughput/TTFT/TPOT curves show no sustained temporal deterioration or additional discontinuous cliff. Output throughput decreases smoothly across increasing input bands; this is disclosed, not described as constant throughput across context lengths.

final_cost.reason: Same-rate, same-card unit output-token cost falls62.89%; the four-tenant formal phase sustains82.77% average sampled AI Core utilization, with both cards above80% and all four tenants completing requests.

qualitative_assessment.generalization: Only the declared original-task bands, C8/C24 concurrency, hardware/model and300s windows were tested. No all-length, unbounded-duration, tenant-isolation or task-quality equivalence claim.

optimization_findings: At32K the sampled AI Core utilization is88.99%, versus66.32% in the short band. Longer-prefill work is a stronger limiting-factor candidate than simply increasing client concurrency; utilization alone does not identify an operator.
C24/four tenants improve short-band throughput45.52% overC8 but increase mean TTFT and TPOT. Treat capacity/latency as a conditional tradeoff, not a universal default.
Individual windows with worse B1 tail latency are retained explicitly. The full phase ratios include every response and final drain; no best-window selection.
